subject: Request: Withholding evidence & ledger offset for invoice 2027-03-INV-5492
raw_messages:
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cortecorp.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: CorteCorp Finance <finance@cortecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:18:00 -0700
Subject: Withholding on inv 2027-03-INV-5492 — request for ledger offset and docs

Hi Diego,

Hope you’re well. We processed payment for invoice 2027-03-INV-5492 this week, but our AP team applied a 12% withholding at source per our local tax rules, which reduced the net we wired to the account.

We can either:
- accept a credit memo for the withheld amount to be applied to the next invoice, or
- receive a refund for the withheld portion so we can reconcile on our side.

Before we can do the latter, our tax team requires proof from Redwood that the withholding is covered (a tax residency / withholding certificate from Redwood’s tax authority or an official statement). I’m attaching our remittance advice for the payment and can provide a copy of the withholding voucher from CorteCorp if helpful.

Can Redwood:
1) confirm the withheld amount on your end,
2) issue a credit memo or instructions for a refund, and
3) confirm what documentation you will provide so we can close this out with our AP team?

We’d like to close by end of next week if possible.

Thanks —
Lena Ortiz
Manager, Accounts Payable
CorteCorp
[attachment: remittance-advice-5492.pdf]
From: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cortecorp.com>, CorteCorp Finance <finance@cortecorp.com>
Date: Fri, 9 Apr 2027 09:37:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Withholding on inv 2027-03-INV-5492 — request for ledger offset and docs

Thanks for flagging this, Lena.

Monica — can you confirm the invoice balance and the net we received? Grace — can you loop in the AM if we need to approve a goodwill credit vs. a formal credit memo?

Quick notes from my side:
- Our records show invoice 2027-03-INV-5492 total = $102,876.00; per Lena the wired amount was short by ~12% (approx $12,345.12).
- We typically issue a credit memo when customers withhold at source and provide a withholding certificate to substantiate the tax. If CorteCorp needs a refund instead, we’ll need to coordinate with Finance (Monica) for ACH reversal timelines.

Monica — next steps please: verify receipt, prepare a draft credit memo showing the withheld line (include VAT/Tax reconciliation if applicable), and note any exchange-rate rounding. If we need to issue a cash refund, state the expected processing ETA.

Diego
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cortecorp.com>, CorteCorp Finance <finance@cortecorp.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Apr 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Withholding on inv 2027-03-INV-5492 — request for ledger offset and docs

Hi all — I pulled the bank trace and confirmed we received $90,530.88 against the invoice (net of 12% withholding). That matches Lena’s remittance advice.

I’ve attached a draft credit memo for $12,345.12 that offsets the withheld amount. The memo includes:
- original invoice reference (2027-03-INV-5492)
- withheld line: 12% withholding (country: US state — internal tax code)
- rounding / exchange-rate note
If CorteCorp can provide a formal withholding certificate (or tax-residency proof) we’ll mark the credit as "Tax-substantiated withholding" which is preferred for both ledgers. If you cannot provide that, please confirm and we’ll escalate for an internal goodwill credit approval (Grace will advise on commercial sign-off).

Attachments: credit-memo-5492.pdf (draft)

ETA for a finalized credit memo: 2 business days after we receive the withholding certificate. If CorteCorp prefers a cash ACH refund instead, Monica: processing will take 5-7 business days after approval.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Revenue Operations — Billing
Redwood Inference
From: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cortecorp.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
Cc: CorteCorp Finance <finance@cortecorp.com>, cortecorp-tax@cortecorp.com
Date: Tue, 13 Apr 2027 08:26:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Withholding on inv 2027-03-INV-5492 — request for ledger offset and docs

Thanks Monica — attaching the signed withholding certificate from CorteCorp tax counsel. We can accept a credit memo applied to the next invoice. Please remove any language about "goodwill" — our auditors prefer formal credit memos tied to withholding certificates.

We’ve attached: cortecorp-withholding-cert.pdf (signed), and the remittance advice (already sent). If you need any additional attestation (company stamp, certifying signature), let me know and I’ll get procurement to provide it.

Lena
Lena Ortiz
Manager, Accounts Payable
CorteCorp
[attachment: cortecorp-withholding-cert.pdf]
From: Diego Fernández <diego.fernandez@redwood.com>
To: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: Lena Ortiz <lena.ortiz@cortecorp.com>, CorteCorp Finance <finance@cortecorp.com>
Date: Sun, 11 Apr 2027 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: Final: credit memo issued for inv 2027-03-INV-5492 (CM-5492)

Update for the thread — finalizing and closing loop.

Monica: please proceed to issue the finalized credit memo CM-5492 for $12,345.12 (attached). I’ve authorized classification as "Tax-substantiated withholding" based on the certificate from CorteCorp.

Operational notes:
- Credit memo CM-5492 will be applied to CorteCorp’s next invoice cycle (2027-05), and will appear on the customer ledger immediately.
- No cash refund required per customer preference. If CorteCorp requests a refund in the future we’ll route through Finance and expect 5–7 business days to process.
- I’m adding the HubSpot record link (above) for account continuity.

Attachments: credit-memo-5492.pdf, cortecorp-withholding-cert.pdf

Diego Fernández
Director, Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
[attachment: credit-memo-5492.pdf]
